name: YUV → Composite (NTSC/PAL)
description: Second stage: modulate chroma onto subcarrier and add to luma to produce the composite baseband signal.

stages.name: Colour Burst Reference
stages.description: 8–10 cycle burst of the subcarrier inserted during horizontal blanking. Provides phase reference for decoder.

stages.name: NTSC Chroma Modulation
stages.description: Modulate U/V onto 3.579545 MHz quadrature subcarrier.

stages.name: PAL Chroma Modulation
stages.description: Modulate U/V onto 4.433618 MHz subcarrier with V-axis phase inversion on alternate lines.

stages.name: Composite Signal Summation
stages.description: Add luma (Y), modulated chroma (C), sync pulses, and burst to form the composite signal: E = Y + C.
